text: {"text":"Hello {first_name}, this is {clinic_name}. We wrote to you before about a follow-up visit. We still have not heard back, so we are writing once more. Please book a visit by {due_by}. You can call us at {clinic_phone}. We are happy to help you find a time. If you do not want these reminders, you can stop them here: {opt_out_link}. Thank you."}
